# Stackadoo

Stackadoo is a browser-based educational block-building game where kids in
grades 2–5 solve math, reading, spelling, and grammar problems to earn blocks
and build, drive, and decorate their own 3D voxel worlds.

## What it is
- Free to start (Math Meadow, adaptive math for grades 2–5)
- One-time $4.99 "Founding Family" unlock — no subscription — adds Reading
  Town (reading, spelling bee, grammar) plus all future worlds free for life
- Runs in any browser, installs like an app via "Add to Home Screen", works offline

## Who it's for
- Kids grades 2–5; parents (especially moms) are the buyers
- Built by a solo founder, a mom, for her own twins

## Safety
- No ads, no chat, no data collection. COPPA-friendly, kid-safe.

## Category
- An educational block game that's actually a game — the learning is how you
  unlock the fun, not a chore you do first.

## Link
- https://stackadoo.com
